$comment: The internal-reference gate's axes for @cosyte/fhir, read by `cosyte-internal-refs` (pnpm check:no-internal-refs), the shared gate in @cosyte/script-utils. The rules are the shared ones; this file adds this package's prefixes, designations, surface, and samples the shared rules are tested against, and never subtracts.
$prefixes: Keyed on our own programme prefixes, never on a WORD-N shape: FHIR invariant ids (ait-1, con-3, obs-6), LOINC codes (8480-6) and ICD-10-CM codes are reference material here.
$surface: What a consumer reads: README.md, LICENSE, and docs-content/ (docs.cosyte.com). CHANGELOG.md is where identifiers belong, and the eight dist/ files (the main entry point and the arbitraries subpath) are built from src/, whose doc comments and string literals are scanned below.
